editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: OANDA is an NFA/CFTC-regulated broker scoring 7.6/10 from NAFT in 2026. Six regulatory licences, $0 minimum deposit, and per-unit position sizing. One of the oldest forex brokers (since 1996). No raw ECN option. TradingView integration. Best for US traders wanting $0 barrier to entry with maximum flexibility, and international traders valuing heritage and regulatory depth over raw cost.
